ABOUT THE CHAPTER

WHO WE ARE

IEEE Computer Society SPIT is the student branch chapter of the world's premier technical computing society at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology, Mumbai — a community of engineers, builders, and innovators committed to excellence.

From intensive technical workshops to national hackathons, industry panels to competitive programming — every program bridges academia and the fast-evolving global technology landscape.

  • 2012 · Chapter FoundedEstablished as one of Mumbai's premier IEEE CS student chapters.
  • 2015 · First HackSPIT200+ participants; regional recognition from IEEE India Council.
  • 2018 · Outstanding Chapter AwardRecognised by IEEE Region 10.
  • 2021 · Virtual Innovation Series30 events reaching 5,000+ students globally.
